capabilities: preview proposed marker conversions with before/after lines
convert Arabic-Indic and Persian numbered markers to native Markdown lists
scope commands to a selection or the whole note
skip protected regions such as code, frontmatter and math blocks
apply or cancel fixes with undo support
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown formatter or linter; it only rewrites Arabic-Indic list markers after an explicit preview and Apply.
extras: Free and local with no network requests or accounts; install is manual from GitHub releases pending directory approval, and the author directs testing claims to a VALIDATION.md file. Requires Obsidian 1.14.5+.
problem: Copied Arabic or Persian numbered instructions often arrive as plain paragraphs, and Markdown list markers require Latin digits, so the text is not a real list.
summary: Preview-based converter that turns Arabic-Indic and Persian numbered list markers into native Markdown list markers without changing item text.
